newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wing On shrs up on strong interim growth.
newsitem.headline: Wing On shrs up on strong interim growth.

text.p: Shares of department store operator Wing On Co International Ltd rose on Monday morning after the company reported a better-than-expected growth in interim net profit, brokers said.
Wing On shares rose HK$0.60 or 8.22 percent to HK$7.90 in late morning with 293,000 shares traded.
The company said on Friday it posted a 32.5 percent rise in net profit to HK$139.99 million in the six months ended June 30.
